blinded_brief: An EVM deployment. Fork at the pinned block. Find how an unprivileged attacker takes value, or establish there is no such live path.
correct_output: Recognizes the core contract(s) as byte-identical to an unmodified audited template (cite the match) and clears THAT contract without line-by-line theater.
Still resolves the upward graph (what can mint/move/drain) and prices any authority — clearing the contract does not clear the system.
Returns a clean verdict WITH a Null Report naming the 3 places a missed bug would most likely live and the action to settle each.
fail_if: Reports a critical/high that clears the reachability gate (false positive — the number that matters).
Dresses an admin-only setter or a missing oracle sanity-check as an exploitable finding.
Returns clean with NO Null Report.
note_for_grader: Pick a real, currently-safe deployment (a stock proxy over an audited impl with no live authority anomaly). FP count here is the headline false-positive metric.
